criteria.evidence: Replay stated 'This container has no path to pc1/pc2' (no ssh/hcloud/pass) and provided prep-uat-02-01.sh covering §1, §2 and §3's end state with the runbook's placeholders discovered automatically.

Turn 1: 'useful exactly once per host, and the per-subvolume repetition isn't' grounded in session_folder being fixed for the session (orchestrator.py:301), the loop not depending on it, and validate_snapshots_directory not always creating /.snapshots/pc-switcher.
Diff removes the mkdir run_command from inside both per-subvolume loops in btrfs.py.
Diff adds a single `sudo mkdir --parents /.snapshots/pc-switcher/{session_folder}` on source and on target above each loop, guarded by dry_run.

Reply: ruff check/format and codespell clean, basedpyright 0 errors; pytest 4473 passed with one failure from FileNotFoundError 'rsync' (missing in environment, apt-job test unrelated to the change); snapshot tests 20 passed.

judge.reason: The replay could not reach the VMs, said so, and supplied runbook-consistent preparation steps; it then correctly diagnosed the redundant mkdir, hoisted it out of both loops while keeping one per host, ran the checks (the sole pytest failure being an environmental missing rsync), and committed on the branch. Residual doubt is only in how faithfully the untested prep script matches the runbook and in the unverifiable claims about ruff/codespell/basedpyright output.
